note: Set B is better because it preserves entity names much more accurately (e.g., 'ORGANIZER VOLTAGE MONITORING' vs Set A's 'ORGANIZER VOLTAGE MO'). Set A contains multiple nonsensical fragments ('ACLES', 'TACLE', 'PTACLE') resulting from poor text extraction alignment. While both sets struggle with precise circuit number bindings (often grouping odd/even pairs), Set B's claims are more readable and structurally consistent, whereas Set A includes vague claims ('Main Panel | circuit breaker load') and significant binding errors (e.g., Wiser Power Meter bound to circuits 31-34 instead of 33-34).
